title: Perverse subcategories of the first kind
statement:
In the setting of [def-per-support-condition], put

$$
\begin{aligned}
{}^pD^{\le0}(X)&:=\bigl\{K:\ \operatorname{SuppCon}(K)\bigr\},\\
{}^pD^{\ge0}(X)&:=\bigl\{K:\ \operatorname{CosuppCon}(K)\bigr\},
\end{aligned}
$$

and, for every $n\in\mathbf Z$,

$$
{}^pD^{\le n}(X):={}^pD^{\le0}(X)[-n],\qquad
{}^pD^{\ge n}(X):={}^pD^{\ge0}(X)[-n].
$$

The *perverse heart candidate* is

$$
\mathrm{Perv}^{\mathrm{cand}}(X):={}^pD^{\le0}(X)\cap{}^pD^{\ge0}(X).
$$

lean.statement: def QbarPerverseHeart : ObjectProperty (generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
lean.note: §1(B): the previous IsPerverseLE/GE/HeartCandidate are predicates on DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A); their own documentation excludes a discrete non-torsion interpretation. They cannot accept the actual intrinsic common-stage l-adic objects of this consumer. The dependency module publicly preserves those definitions and the previous PBC support interface, then states the same shifted support/cosupport classes and their intersection on the recorded intrinsic rational/common-stage category over any field with invertible l.
